t: This is In Pensioner, a sculpture by Mary Catterall. Catterall, who lived from 1922 to 2015, was a British medical doctor and sculptor, and she was also an environmentalist. So the person who made this figure came to sculpture alongside a career in medicine. The title suggests a pensioner, and the work is a portrait of that kind of person in bronze or stone form. Take a moment to look at the face and posture, and at the way the figure sits in its surroundings.
